# EvDataTableCell

> One cell of a DataTable - a th in the header with an optional sort control, a td in the body. Whatever the cell holds goes in its slot.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:data-table-cell` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvDataTableCell } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvDataTableCell>` or `<ev-data-table-cell>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/data-table/EvDataTableCell.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root element `.ev-data-table__cell` |
| Used inside | `evoq-ui:data-table-row` (EvDataTableRow) |

```vue
<EvDataTableCell
  header
  sortable
>
```

## Props (6)

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Renders a `th` in the header row rather than a `td` in the body. |
| `sortable` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Draws the sort glyph the board puts on every `.Table Item` in a title row. |
| `sort` | `'none'` \| `'asc'` \| `'desc'` | `'none'` | no | Which way the column is sorted right now. |
| `align` | `'left'` \| `'center'` \| `'right'` | `'left'` | no | — |
| `fixed` | `'left' \| 'right' \| false` | `false` | no | Pins the column while the table scrolls sideways. |
| `offset` | `number \| string` | `0` | no | Distance from the pinned edge, for a second pinned column. |

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Data Table**, frame `4220:74017` (Data Table). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Display large, structured datasets that users need to scan, sort, filter, compare, select, and act on — admin lists, records, transactions, reports.

### When not to use

- For a handful of items or simple key-value pairs → use a list or description list. For non-tabular content → use Cards. On small mobile screens, prefer stacked cards.

### Do

- Right-align numeric columns. Keep headers sortable and concise. Freeze key columns (Left/Right Fixed) for wide tables. Provide pagination or virtual scroll for large sets.

### Don't

- Don't cram too many columns without a fixed/scroll strategy. Don't mix wildly different data types in one column. Don't hide critical actions off-screen.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvDataTableCell`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root element `.ev-data-table__cell`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:data-table-cell` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
